hourly.title: A collapsible section's summary: the hourly history table.
hourly.caption: Caption of an hourly table.
memory-limit: Column heading: memory in use against its limit.
of-limit: {{share}} is a formatted number (percent of the memory limit in use).
host.title: Card title on the Health page of the Operations dashboard: the server's resources, for the whole host machine.
host.description: {{seconds}} is how often a sample is taken (or … while loading). "Deployment services" is deployment.title.
host.last-sample: {{when}} is a date and time, or host.no-samples.
host.no-samples: {{when}} in host.last-sample when the server has taken no resource sample yet.
host.metric.rssBytes: Each host.metric.*: a measurement of the server, as a label (and the table's column heading for rssBytes).
host.metric.cpuPercent: The Socio server process's CPU use, in percent.
host.metric.load1: The host machine's load average over the last minute.
host.metric.load5: The host machine's load average over the last 5 minutes.
host.metric.load15: The host machine's load average over the last 15 minutes.
host.metric.volumeBytes: The total size of the disk volume that holds Socio's data.
host.metric.volumeFreeBytes: Free space on the disk volume that holds Socio's data.
host.metric.databasePages: How many pages (storage blocks, not Spaces' pages) the database file has.
host.metric.databaseFreePages: Unused pages (storage blocks, not Spaces' pages) inside the database file.
host.metric.walBytes: WAL: the database's write-ahead log; keep the abbreviation.
host.metric.datasetBytes: The size of datasets (tables of data), measured once a day.
host.metric.fileBytes: The size of stored files, measured once a day.
host.metric.mediaBytes: The size of stored media (images, audio, video), measured once a day.
host.gaps: Heading: metrics that aren't being collected.
host.gap-stale: {{metric}} is one of host.metric.*; {{when}} a date and time.
host.samples: Column heading: how many samples an hour's average is taken over.
host.volume-free: Column heading: free space on the data volume.
deployment.title: Card title: the containers (services) this deployment runs.
deployment.description: "Socios" are AI agents (product noun); "orchestrator": the container platform (Docker Swarm).
deployment.last-sample: <time/> is the sample's date and time.
deployment.state.off: Keep COMPUTER_DISK_USAGE_URL as is: it's a setting's name.
deployment.total.cpuPercent: A total's label: the CPU use of all the deployment's services together.
deployment.total.services: A total's label: how many services (containers) the deployment runs.
deployment.total.unlimitedServices: A total's label on the Health page: how many of the deployment's services (containers) run with no memory limit set.
deployment.total.restarts: A total's label: how many times the services' containers restarted.
deployment.of-limits: {{used}} and {{limit}} are sizes (4 GiB): memory in use, of the sum of the services' memory limits.
deployment.limits-meter: Accessible name of a bar showing memory in use against the limits.
deployment.of-one-cpu: {{cpu}} is a percent of one CPU (150% is one and a half).
deployment.cpu-meter: Accessible name of a bar showing CPU use against the node's CPUs.
deployment.node-cpus: {{share}} is a formatted number; {{count}} how many CPUs the node (the host machine) has.
deployment.against-node: Label: the deployment's memory against the node's (the host machine's).
deployment.node-meter: Accessible name of a bar showing memory use against the node's memory.
deployment.node-shared: Beside the node memory bar: the host machine also runs other customers' services.
deployment.computers: A row standing for every socio's computer together (socios are AI agents).
deployment.kind.stack: Each deployment.kind.*: what kind of service a row is.
deployment.kind.plugin: A row's kind: a service that a plugin added.
deployment.kind.computer: A row's kind: the containers of socios' computers (sandboxes the AI agents work in).
deployment.containers: After a row's kind: how many containers the service runs.
deployment.no-limit-badge: Badge on a service without a memory limit.
deployment.no-limit: In the Memory / limit column: the service has no memory limit.
deployment.service-meter: Accessible name of a bar; {{service}} is the service's name.
deployment.node: Column heading: the host machine a service runs on.
computers.title: Card title: socios' computers (sandboxes the AI agents work in).
computers.description: "OOM": out of memory; keep the abbreviation.
computers.disk-missing.off: Each computers.disk-missing.*: in the disk column, why there is no reading.
computers.disk-missing.pending: In the disk column: the computer's disk use hasn't been measured yet.
computers.disk-missing.unavailable: In the disk column: the last reading failed or is out of date.
computers.disk-off: Keep COMPUTER_DISK_USAGE_URL as is: it's a setting's name.
computers.disk-unavailable: {{count}} is how many minutes between tries.
computers.disk-measured: {{count}} is how many minutes between measurements.
computers.running: A computer's status in its row: it is running now.
computers.stopped: A computer's status in its row: it is not running now.
computers.status-unavailable: A computer's status when it couldn't be read.
computers.no-samples: In a computer's row when no resource sample was taken yet.
computers.metric.cpuPercent: Each computers.metric.*: a measurement of a computer.
computers.metric.memoryBytes: A measurement of a computer: the memory it actively uses (its working set).
computers.metric.memoryLimitBytes: A measurement of a computer: its memory limit.
computers.metric.volumeBytes: A measurement of a computer: the size of the disk volumes it owns.
computers.metric.containerBytes: A measurement of a computer: the size of its container's own layer on disk.
computers.unlimited: In the Memory / limit column: no memory limit.
computers.container-layer: {{size}} is a size: the computer's container layer on disk.
computers.last-oom: When an app last ran out of memory; <time/> is a date and time.
computers.socio: Column heading: the socio (AI agent) a computer belongs to.
computers.app-ooms: Column heading: how many times apps ran out of memory.
